rules.statement: A wife seeking to set aside a fraudulent assignment of mortgage bonds cannot do so as the assets represented by the mortgage bonds are not available for execution under maintenance orders.
rules.supporting_quote: "It will be seen that the words used are 'by distress and sale' and not by seizure and sale as is found in the Civil Procedure Code. It is argued that 'distress' can only be levied on property that is corporeal in its nature, on something that can pass by delivery."
